adr-0067-go-docs.note: ADR 0067's facts about the Go gateway. The gateway pages name no header form for any path; the form is the one ADR 0067 records, and the `/messages` and `/responses` paths wait for a live item to observe it.

first-live-run.note: The eight test items of the first live Run, `S40/smoke/1` of 2026-09-07, recorded on #307; their responses live in the ADR 0067 Provider Result Cache outside every checkout.

json-object-live-item.note: The one live item that put a format constraint on this gateway (#306): the gateway accepted `response_format: {"type":"json_object"}` and the unit that had answered empty returned a JSON object. One item is one response; it shows the field is accepted, not that the constraint is honoured on every response.

go-plan-docs.note: The Go page for which path the gateway serves each model on, the Zen model table for the exact id it answers to: both facts or no row. The Go page also prints the `x-opencode-session` header for session stability (ADR 0080 §3), which is why the Go routes send it and no other route does.

v41-go-wire-contract.note: The pinned pre-move Go table and SDK choices[0].message.content contract establish declared wire compatibility only. On 2026-10-12 OpenCode moved its docs; current https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/bcf23b6775c79a429b1511b255d6d88ab0248d4a/services/www/src/docs/content/console/go.mdx publishes /inference/go instead. This binding retains explicitly selected /zen/go, whose named V4.1 product captures observe compatibility; no inference/go equivalence or validation is claimed. No V4.1 live capability is inferred from V4 evidence. JSON-object format, reasoning channel, usage attribution, tools and context remain unverified until named actual product evidence.

v41-product-channels.note: Actual built AI7 baseline analysis under v9/v7 on exact Public sample1, code head 39c5ac4113d5b5c09e96e23585ddca8f7b4959c0 (#807). All 12 responses name deepseek-v4.1-flash and contain message.content and reasoning_content strings. Seven of eight unit contracts closed; unit 1 retained a schema-invalid gap. Cross-unit reduction, assurance sampling and reflection closed. This observes response channels only, not a format guarantee, usage attribution, tools, context or universal editorial quality. Protected captures and durable business result remain in the original external cache root.

v41-dialogue-sse.note: Issue #833: one minimal frozen-dialogue-contract probe on exact sample1 through the repository gate, broker and durable pre-send claim returned HTTP 200 text/event-stream with deepseek-v4.1-flash, 69 events, finish_reason stop and DONE. The completed live continuation after a mid-stream stop also observed SSE; the aborted ask /2 remains outcome-unknown and is not mirrored as a transmitted result. This establishes SSE transport capability only. External protected capture root: 833-stream/probe-cache.

routes.note: The developer-live route of Provider Processing v16 (ADR 0065, ADR 0067), selected by active-policy-set v12; also one of the two routes the editor may choose under ordinary-production v17. On this gateway a 429, a 402 or a body naming the usage limit is the development account's limit, so it ends the Run or dialogue attempt. The Session header carries the technical Session id for the gateway's prompt cache. Named by the documentation and deliberately absent, because the Zen table states no id for them: LongCat-2.0, Hy4 preview, Hy3, Omen Alpha, MiMo-V2.5, MiMo-V2.5-Pro.

models.note: Historical V4 profile, retained with its original evidence; no current product binding selects it. It sends no DeepSeek-specific parameter. Its toolCalling stays none: the Owner's own session observed a client tool call through this gateway (ADR 0080 §5.3), which is not yet a recorded live-test item.

The developer-live product binding of Provider Processing v16 for baseline analysis, editorial dialogue, review (cross-deliverable consistency, 事实核查 and 学术道德与引用 included), writing, the three evaluation contracts, and 润色 and conflict-regeneration Suggestions eligibility; review, writing, evaluation and dialogue may also name AI7's platform tools under v16. Request shape is a declared vendor wire contract; answer and reasoning channels have their own named V4.1 product observations. Sends no unverified format, reasoning-control or tool parameters. Old V4 items establish none of this model's capabilities.
The same model id as the production route's, behind a different route: a different profile, and no capability carries across.

models.displayName: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp（OpenCode Go）

routes.note: The same plan, account and credential slot over the Anthropic-compatible path. The shape requires a per-turn output cap; 32,768 leaves headroom above the largest unit output observed to date (24,225 tokens) and bounds one turn only, the Run Budget Ceiling being the authority over the Run. MiniMax is here on a disagreement: the Go page places it on `/messages`, the Zen table on `chat/completions`; the Go page decides until a live item settles it. Qwen3.8 Flash is absent: the Go page places it here but the Zen table stated no id for it on 2026-09-08.

The same plan over the OpenAI-compatible Responses path. `max_output_tokens` is optional on this shape and nothing has established a per-turn bound for these models, so the route names none. Muse Spark 1.3 / 1.2 are absent: the Go page prints `muse-spark-1.3-contributor` / `muse-spark-1.2-contributor`, the Zen table `muse-spark-1.3` / `muse-spark-1.2`, so no id is stated by both. The Zen table's further `/responses` rows are Zen rather than the Go plan.

openQuestions: Whether any inert model on the three paths accepts a request at all, and which path MiniMax actually answers on, is settled only by a named live test item under ADR 0067.
